nodes.description: Immutable address of the logic (implementation) contract; set once in the constructor and read by the fallback delegatecall target.
Constructor that stores the implementation address and performs a raw delegatecall into it with attacker-supplied initialization calldata.
Payable fallback that copies calldata and raw-delegatecalls into the immutable logic address, forwarding gas and returning/reverting with the raw result.
Constructor parameter _logic: the implementation address written into the immutable state variable logic.
Constructor parameter _initializationCalldata: arbitrary calldata forwarded verbatim into the delegatecall of the logic contract.
Raw delegatecall in the constructor to _logic with fully controlled initialization calldata, executing arbitrary code in the proxy storage context.
Raw assembly delegatecall in the fallback to the stored logic address, forwarding caller calldata and all gas in the proxy storage context.

edges.reason: The constructor parameter _logic is assigned to the immutable state variable logic, propagating the implementation address into storage.
The constructor writes the logic state variable, establishing the implementation address used by every subsequent delegatecall.
The constructor executes the initialization delegatecall and requires it to succeed, reverting with the returned reason otherwise.
The caller-supplied _logic address is the target of the constructor delegatecall, letting the deployer choose arbitrary executed code.
The caller-supplied _initializationCalldata is forwarded unvalidated to the constructor delegatecall, allowing arbitrary function dispatch in the proxy context.
The immutable logic address is read as the delegatecall target in the fallback, so every external call executes untrusted implementation code inside the proxy's storage context.
The fallback unconditionally performs a full-gas delegatecall on every incoming call, allowing re-entrant execution of implementation logic before state settles.
The fallback loads the logic state variable to derive the local _impl address used in the assembly delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter _logic exists only to initialize the immutable logic state variable and to target the constructor delegatecall, so it should be normalized into the constructor core function.
The constructor parameter _initializationCalldata has no independent semantics beyond being forwarded verbatim into the initialization delegatecall, so it should be merged into that unsafe operation.
